grants.witnessCaption: The decoded payload. A claim not shown and not named by the grant is unconstrained, but for azp; repository_owner is not shown because it was not evaluated, so whether it excludes a token is not decided here. It sets no azp: AWS reads aud from azp whenever a token sets one.
